rationale: All six prior blocking findings are resolved on current source at HEAD c0cccd2631: bare dict annotations parameterized, save_history=false short-circuits the pre-flight, composite paging capped at 50 pages with a 422, and the three test gaps now have tests. The test-gap fixes (CR-002 in the untracked test_main_validation_handler.py, CR-004 and CR-006 in test_run_attributes_money.py) were verified by reading, not by running; the targeted tests belong to Stage 7 execution.

findings.title: Bare dict annotations in new signatures
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) says to prefer parameterized generics over bare list/dict annotations in new code; the change adds signatures annotated with bare dict: run_attributes.py:120, request_spend.py:48,76,136, workflow_handler.py:463, query_pipeline.py:89,416,417,422,876,879.
findings.impact: A documented code-quality standard is unmet in new code, so the standards row is partial and blocks the workflow.
findings.recommendation: Parameterize the annotations in the new or changed signatures, for example dict[str, Any] and list[dict[str, Any]].
findings.check_notes: Annotations parameterized in run_attributes.py, request_spend.py, workflow_handler.py:463 and query_pipeline.py; no added line on the branch carries a bare dict annotation

fix.change: Parameterized bare dict/list[dict] annotations in new signatures (run_attributes, request_spend, workflow_handler, query_pipeline)

findings.title: Global 422 sanitizer change has no test
findings.problem: _sanitize_error now backslash-escapes strings, sanitizes dict keys and runs over the whole error dict (previously only input). The change exists to keep lone-surrogate attribute values from crashing the JSONResponse, yet no test exercises validation_exception_handler or _sanitize_error; the surrogate tests stop at the pydantic ValidationError.
findings.impact: Reverting or breaking the handler turns a lone-surrogate attribute into an encoding failure (500) on every body-validated route, and the broadened sanitization of loc, ctx and keys is unpinned. Reachability not exhaustively confirmed; the global handler is a live path.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that posts or simulates a body with attributes {'team': '\ud800'} through validation_exception_handler (or calls _sanitize_error on such an error dict) and asserts a 422 JSON body with the surrogate escaped, loc as a list and ctx stringified.
findings.check_notes: main.py unchanged; new untracked test_main_validation_handler.py drives validation_exception_handler and _sanitize_error with a lone surrogate (not run)

fix.change: Added tests pinning _sanitize_error and validation_exception_handler for lone-surrogate attribute values

findings.title: Attributes pre-flight ignores save_history=false
findings.problem: RUN_ATTRIBUTES_REQUEST_DESC promises attributes are ignored when save_history is false, but validate_run_attributes_and_raise never reads save_history. It runs unconditionally from _ask_assistant and inference_virtual and loads the conversation whenever attributes and conversation_id are present.
findings.impact: A save_history=false request naming a conversation that has history, with attributes differing from the stored ones, gets a 422 instead of being ignored, contradicting the published contract and the non-goal that save_history=false is not extended.
findings.recommendation: Return early when request.save_history is false (for example `if not request.attributes or not request.save_history or not request.conversation_id: return`) and add a test for save_history=false with differing attributes on a conversation that has history.
findings.check_notes: utils.py:133 returns early when save_history is false; test asserts the conversation is not loaded

fix.change: validate_run_attributes_and_raise returns early when save_history is false

findings.title: Filtered Assistants-chats pricing not tested via public method
findings.problem: get_assistants_chats builds filters and passes them through a partial to _enrich_assistants_spending. Tests call only the private enricher with filters, and the public method with attributes only against an empty ES|QL result, so the filters=filters argument is unobserved.
findings.impact: Dropping filters from the partial makes an attributes-filtered Assistants-chats table show each assistant's full ledger spend next to filtered run counts, with no test failing.
findings.recommendation: Add a handler-level test calling get_assistants_chats(attributes=...) with one assistant row and a composite requests page; assert spend_service.aggregate_by_dimension is not awaited and total_cost_usd equals the ledger sum of the filtered request ids.
findings.check_notes: test_get_assistants_chats_prices_only_the_filtered_requests calls the public method with attributes; handler passes filters=filters to the enricher (not run)

fix.change: Added public-method test for get_assistants_chats(attributes=...) ledger pricing

findings.title: Unbounded composite paging in collect_request_usage
findings.problem: collect_request_usage loops over a composite aggregation until after_key is exhausted and keeps every (group, request id) bucket in memory, with no page, row or time cap. workflows-executions runs it over every execution in range for each page request, and attributes-usage and the filtered workflows and assistants-chats paths do the same; the paging is also done without a PIT.
findings.impact: A wide date range means unbounded Elasticsearch round trips and memory growth per analytics request, ending in timeouts or memory pressure even when one row was requested.
findings.recommendation: Cap pages (or collected buckets) and fail with a 503 or narrow-the-range 422 when the cap is exceeded, instead of looping until exhaustion.
findings.check_notes: MAX_REQUEST_USAGE_PAGES=50 raises a 422 beyond the cap; tests cover exhaustion and the cap

fix.change: collect_request_usage caps composite pages (MAX_REQUEST_USAGE_PAGES=50) and raises 422 asking for a narrower range

findings.title: Filtered Workflows pricing not tested via public method
findings.problem: get_workflows builds filters, passes them to _enrich_workflows_spending through a row_enricher lambda and toggles pre_floor on attributes. Tests drive only the private enricher with hand-built filters, and the public method with attributes only over empty buckets, so the enricher takes the old path there.
findings.impact: If filters or the pre_floor toggle is lost, an attributes-filtered Workflows table silently shows the whole workflow's name-keyed ledger cost next to filtered run counts, and no test fails.
findings.recommendation: Add a handler-level test calling WorkflowHandler.get_workflows(attributes=...) with a non-empty workflow bucket and a composite requests page; assert total_cost_usd is the per-execution ledger sum and spend_service.aggregate_by_dimension is not awaited.
findings.check_notes: test_get_workflows_prices_only_the_filtered_executions calls get_workflows(attributes=...) over a non-empty bucket (not run)

fix.change: Added public-method test for WorkflowHandler.get_workflows(attributes=...) per-execution ledger pricing

final_round.rationale: The diff is oversized, so the round could not cover all of it and confidence is low; the four lenses and the standards audit all ran, and 2.3 reachability checks were targeted rather than exhaustive. Six blocking findings: save_history=false still gets the attributes 422 despite the published contract, unbounded composite paging in request pricing, three untested changed paths (global 422 sanitizer, filtered Workflows and Assistants-chats pricing) and bare dict annotations that leave code-quality partial. 0 deferred; 20 candidates dismissed as noise or already handled (spec-authorized behavior, deep paging maps to 400, other metric callers and entry points carry no attributes).
